name: Instagram Feed & Carousel

counting.notes: Caption URLs are NOT clickable. Hashtag hard cap was slashed from 30 to 5 in Dec 2025.

hashtags.excessBehavior: Tags beyond 5 are rejected or ignored since Instagram's Dec 2025 5-hashtag cap.
hashtags.notes: Instagram reduced max hashtags from 30 to 5 in Dec 2025 (@creators / Adam Mosseri). Focus on natural caption SEO & alt text.

links.recommendedStrategy: Do not paste raw URLs in captions (non-clickable dead text). Use Story link stickers, bio link, or organic DM handoff.
links.notes: Raw URLs in IG feed captions cannot be tapped.

feedToGrid.label: IG 4:5 Feed -> 3:4 Profile Grid Safe Box (1012x1350 inner)

oauth.gotcha: 60-day long-lived token has NO refresh token — must call GET /refresh_access_token while token is >24h old AND still active. Expired tokens or password/role changes require manual re-auth. Graph API caps carousels at 10 items (vs 20 native) and rejects 3:4 uploads (Error 36003). Meta originality classifiers apply 30-day reach penalty to recycled/aggregated content. Watermarked content (e.g. TikTok logo) is algorithmically suppressed.

sources: Meta for Developers Instagram Platform Docs (8MB JPEG, Graph API 4:5-1.91:1, 10-item API carousel)
Instagram @creators / Adam Mosseri (Dec 18-19, 2025: 5-hashtag cap, 3:4 profile grid)
